headline: Executive order extends the life of certain federal advisory committees and changes two earlier executive orders.
what_it_does: This order keeps certain federal advisory committees running past the date they would otherwise have ended. These committees give advice to the President or federal agencies. The order also makes changes to two earlier executive orders, numbers 13038 and 13054. The title does not say which committees are covered or what the changes are.

who_it_affects.how: People serving on the covered committees can keep doing their advisory work for a longer period.

who_it_affects.group: Federal agencies that use advisory committees
who_it_affects.how: Agencies can keep getting advice from the covered committees instead of losing them when their terms run out.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed September 29, 1997; the exact effective date and how long the committees are extended are not stated in the title.
